events.name: War or conflict scare
events.about: Fighting breaks out or escalates somewhere that matters to trade or energy. Markets often fall at first on the uncertainty.

events.name: Oil price shock
events.about: Oil jumps suddenly, for example after supply is disrupted. It raises costs for airlines, shippers and shoppers.

events.name: Election surprise
events.about: A big vote lands differently from what markets expected, or the outcome is uncertain for days.

events.name: Currency crisis
events.about: A major currency drops sharply or a borrowing trade unwinds, and money rushes to safer places.

events.name: Trade war or tariffs
events.about: New tariffs or trade threats between big economies hit companies that sell or build abroad.

events.name: Banking scare
events.about: Banks fail or wobble and people worry their money is not safe.

events.name: Pandemic shock
events.about: A health emergency shuts down travel and business across the world.

GLD.name: Gold
GLD.catch: Pays no dividend, and it can fall too when the dollar is strong or rates rise.

TLT.name: US government bonds (long)
TLT.catch: Can fall hard when inflation or interest rates are the cause of the storm.

BIL.name: Cash (US Treasury bills)
BIL.catch: Very steady, but it won't grow much and you can miss the rebound.

XLU.name: Utilities
XLU.catch: Steady demand, but sensitive to interest rates.

XLP.name: Consumer staples
XLP.catch: People still buy food and soap, but these grow slowly.

XLV.name: Healthcare
XLV.catch: Needed in any weather, but drug-price politics can hit it.

ITA.name: Defence companies
ITA.catch: Has tended to rise in conflicts, but it depends on government budgets and can fall when tensions ease.

UUP.name: US dollar
UUP.catch: Often rises in a panic, but a strong dollar can reverse quickly.

FXF.name: Swiss franc
FXF.catch: A traditional safe place, but Switzerland's central bank sometimes steps in to weaken it.
